title: A Trial of Equine F (ab')2 Antivenom for Treatment of Scorpion Envenomation in Morocco
brief_summary: This study has the objective to demonstrate the effectiveness of Alacramyn NAMO in the treatment of North Africa and Middle East scorpions envenomation by reducing the severity of envenomation. The primary endpoint is make a comparison between antivenom and placebo groups, at 4 hours after study drug, of the number of cases showing improvement in class of envenomation.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male or female 6 months to 15 years
* Class II B or III scorpion envenomation
* Presenting within 5 hours of sting
* Informed consent read and signed by parent or legal guardian

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unable to provide informed consent
* Prior use of antivenom for this envenomation
* Allergy to horse serum
* Pregnant or breast-feeding
* Patients with underlying condition mimicking symptoms of scorpion envenomation (congenital heart disease, chronic oxygen therapy, etcetera)
